messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty ALERT fired -> service=hosted-inference severity=high. Trigger: 5xx rate > 40% over 2m. Paging primary: Ravi.
Ravi: on it, acked in PD. Checking metrics.
Ava: getting alerts too — saw a spike at 10:42 UTC. Any deploys?
Jordan: no deploys from infra in last hour. Could be a model memory leak on a new quantized shard.
Priya: incident-bot shows a snooze was set on the secondary rotation 3m ago (user snooze via mobile). That might block escalation.
Ravi: I see PD shows primary acked then silent errors continued. Secondary didn't get the page because of snooze.
incident-bot: Escalation policy tried to page secondary -> suppressed by user snooze. Manager fallback scheduled in 6m.
Sam (oncall): that's bad — if secondary suppressed, manager should be next. Did manager get paged?
Priya: PD log: manager notification attempted but PD retry hit rate limiter due to burst. There's a race between snooze and the escalation window.
Ava: customer impact? Any live requests failing?
Ravi: cURL to health endpoint shows 503 on two nodes. A subset of requests are k->k errors, latency up. Customers on hosted tier seeing timeouts. Rolling fanout.
Jordan: I'm running quick query: `SELECT count(*) FROM requests WHERE status >= 500 AND ts > now() - interval '5 minutes';` returning ~1200 errors, concentrated on cluster inference-01.
Ravi: temp mitigation:paused routing to inference-01, enabling fallback pool. Doing now: `rbctl route remove inference-01 --immediate`
Priya: good. Also disabling noisy alert for the escalation window so manager doesn't get duped if PD keeps retrying.
Sam (oncall): please add a note in the incident ticket with actions. I'll take handoff after Ravi stabilizes.
incident-bot: action logged -> ticket #INC-4382 created and linked.
Ava: rollback candidate? Last model push was 04:10 — but customers using the older variant are fine. We can route to model-v2-safe while we investigate.
Jordan: I pushed a temporary routing rule to prefer model-v2-safe for 10m. Watching error rate.
Ravi: errors dropped to ~30/min after removing inference-01 and routing to fallback. Latency back to baseline for most users.
Priya: PD shows manager alert finally fired at 5112233360 after rate limiter window. Manager acknowledged but didn't need to join once we confirmed fallback.
Sam (oncall): thanks — I'll own monitoring until handoff. Ravi, please add postmortem notes about snooze suppression (how snooze interacts with our escalation policy) and propose policy change: always allow manager notify if secondary suppressed AND error-rate > X.
Ravi: will do. Quick checklist: root cause unknown (node-level resource exhaustion or model runtime bug). Collecting debug tar from inference-01 and core dumps.
Ava: collectors running: `diag-collect --host inference-01 --since 10m` -> uploading to artifact store.
Jordan: leaving a short runbook note: if secondary is snoozed and primary ack fails to reduce errors in 5m -> escalate to on-call manager via bypass API. PR incoming.
incident-bot: thread closed for now (status: mitigated). Update ticket when postmortem ready. :white_check_mark:
Sam (oncall): great triage, everyone. Follow-up: schedule a retro with PD policy owners and Eng-ops to adjust escalation race.
Ravi: +1 — will draft timeline and share by EOD.
